title: Years of data, one missing variable
hook: Can experience teach an effect you never notice or vary?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Distinguish accumulated observations from attention to the yield-relevant input.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Distinguish accumulated observations from attention to the yield-relevant input.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy yield rule is two times pod size. A farmer observes five years but only ever uses size two. What yield does that input produce? Toy inputs A=[2, 5]; B=[4, 5].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[4, 2, 5], [8, 4, 5]]. Labels: Model yield, Pod size, Years.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Repeated observation at one input value can leave the effect of changing that input unexamined. The comparison varies pod size and keeps years fixed. More records and a more informative experimental variation are different resources.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Pod size=4, Observed years=5. What is Model yield? Answer: 8.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Pod size=4, Observed years=5. What is Model yield?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 8. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Indonesian seaweed farmers ignored pod size, which mattered for yield, despite years of their own data (Hanna, Mullainathan & Schwartzstein, 2014).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Distinguish accumulated observations from attention to the yield-relevant input.
